description: Workgroup Pinned to an Engine Version
rationale: A workgroup left on AUTO is moved onto the Athena engine version AWS currently supports as it is released. A workgroup pinned to a version stays on it, and AWS eventually stops maintaining that version: the correctness and security fixes that land in later engines never reach the queries of the workgroup, and the eventual move happens on a deadline rather than on a schedule the team chose. Pinning is a deliberate and useful thing to do while a query is being tested against a new engine, and much less useful once it has been forgotten.
remediation: Set the selected engine version of the workgroup back to AUTO once the queries have been validated against the current engine
